headline: 🔴 Oracle HTTP Server CVE-2026-21962 CVSS 10.0 KEV addition, 🛡️ miniOrange WordPress SAML SSO auth bypass CVSS 9.8, 🔓 Critical Zimbra RCE CVE-2026-73570 actively exploited, 🎯 ShinyHunters impersonates ReliaQuest staff in vishing campaign, 🔑 EvilTokens PhaaS abuses Microsoft device codes for M365 hijack, 💊 Red Hat Keycloak CVE-2026-18963 unauthenticated account takeover
summary: CISA added the CVSS 10.0 Oracle HTTP Server flaw CVE-2026-21962 to KEV after confirming active exploitation, while two critical WordPress SAML SSO bypasses enable unauthenticated admin takeover and a critical Zimbra RCE continues mass exploitation. ShinyHunters targeted ReliaQuest in a vishing campaign and EvilTokens emerged as a new PhaaS platform abusing Microsoft device codes to hijack M365 accounts.

overrides.why: CVSS 10.0 KEV addition with confirmed exploitation and 9-month PoC window; highest-impact vulnerability of the day
